curtain.fetching: fetching the books and dictionary, just this once
curtain.taking_longer: this is taking longer than usual…
curtain.books_downloading: the books are still downloading. you can start now, and they'll finish in the background.
curtain.still_loading: still loading. check your connection, then reload. once kalibre has loaded here, it works offline.
curtain.older_tab: kalibre is open in another tab, on an older version. close that tab and this one will carry on.
curtain.couldnt_load: kalibre couldn't load. check your connection, then reload.
curtain.browser_too_old: this browser is too old for kalibre. a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari will run it.

meta.description: Your typing. Your mistakes. Your progress. A typing trainer that learns your recurring mistakes and drills them, right in your browser.
meta.alt_wordmark: The kalibre wordmark between Cal and Libby, with the line: your typing, your mistakes, your progress.

pwa.ios: On iPhone and iPad, add kalibre to your home screen (in Safari: share → add to home screen). It opens full screen and keeps its data, where a Safari tab can lose it after 7 days without a visit.
pwa.generic: Add kalibre to your home screen (the browser's menu → add to home screen, or install). Installed, it opens full screen, and the browser is readier to keep its data.

backup.nothing: there’s nothing to back up yet
backup.saved_to_folder: saved {count, plural, one {# profile file} other {# profile files}} to the kalibre folder “{folder}”
backup.downloaded: downloaded {count, plural, one {# profile file} other {# profile files}}

updates.update_meta: you can update now, or stay on your current version (v{current}).
updates.update_meta_size: download size: ~{size} · you can update now, or stay on your current version (v{current}).
updates.check_offline: couldn’t reach the server just now
updates.check_unavailable: updates only work in the installed or hosted app
updates.breaking_intro: this update changes how kalibre keeps your data:
updates.breaking_note: once it’s done, older versions of kalibre can’t open your data, so save a backup first: a profile file for every profile on this device.
updates.notes_not_yet: the notes for this version show once it’s installed.
updates.stays_at: v{current} stays at {link} for a while; open a backup there to keep using it.

brand.kanary_preview_build_click_for: kanary preview build · click for notice

kanary_notice.features_interfaces_and_database_schemas: features, interfaces, and database schemas are actively evolving and may shift, be replaced, or break without notice.
kanary_notice.your_typing_history_achievements_and: your typing history, achievements, and custom data live in this browser’s local storage. export a backup copy regularly so a breaking update never costs your progress.
kanary_notice.profiles_used_on_kanary_may: profiles used on kanary may or may not work if imported into release versions of kalibre. kanary may introduce newer database schemas, experimental settings, or revised formats that release versions cannot read or migrate backwards.
kanary_notice.intro: you’re using {product}, an early, fast-moving preview build with in-progress experiments.
kanary_notice.follow: follow release milestones, development progress, and announcements on {site}.

older_version.it_keeps_its_own_data: It keeps its own data, apart from the current version’s: to use yours here, import a profile file saved before the update (profile menu → import a profile file).
older_version.this_is_kalibre_v_kept: This is kalibre v{version}, kept so you can go back.
older_version.hide_this_until_the_page: hide this until the page reloads

shortcuts.sequence_hint: press sequence keys (like {first} then {second}) within 1.5 seconds. shortcuts only trigger when not actively typing in tests or text fields.

startup_failure.if_kalibre_was_taken_back: if kalibre was taken back to an older version on purpose, you can put back the copy of your data saved just before it was last updated. anything you did after that update is lost, and it replaces everything kalibre keeps in this browser.
startup_failure.select_the_details_below_to: select the details below to copy them
startup_failure.what_you_ve_saved_is: what you’ve saved is still in this browser: starting again doesn’t touch it.
startup_failure.send_details: if it keeps happening, send the details to {address}.
startup_failure.previous_version_available: the previous kalibre version (v{version}) is still downloaded on this device.
startup_failure.rollback_keeps_data: going back changes the app files, not your saved data. if the older version says your data is newer, put back the copy from before the update.
startup_failure.previous_version_unavailable: the previous version is no longer available

update_gate.kalibre_v_changes_how_it: kalibre v{appVersion} changes how it keeps your data
update_gate.nothing_has_changed_yet_once: nothing has changed yet. once it has, older versions of kalibre can’t open your data, so save a backup first: a profile file for every profile on this device.
update_gate.older_version: or keep using the version before it, at {link}, for now: open your backup there.
